TifoMaker · Engineering plan

Match Day — Hyper-Real Upgrade

Making the 3D preview look ultra-quality and photoreal — the moment fans publish their work.

1 · Why this is the gem

Match Day is the payoff. Someone spends 20 minutes painting 60,000 seats, then opens Match Day to feel it come alive — and that's the frame they screenshot, share, and judge the whole product by. Every 10% of realism here converts directly into shares, publishes, and word-of-mouth. This plan takes the simulator from "good real-time" to "did you record that off the TV?".

2 · Where we are today

The simulator already has strong bones (grounded in src/render/simulator/*):

✅ Already in

  • PBR materials (MeshStandardMaterial throughout)
  • Soft shadows (PCFSoft, up to 4096 maps at Ultra)
  • Bloom (UnrealBloomPass via EffectComposer)
  • ACES Filmic tone mapping
  • Instanced crowd, distance fog, spot-light floodlights
  • Adaptive quality tiers low→ultra with a device probe

❌ Missing for photoreal

  • Image-based lighting (no HDRI/env map) — PBR has no real reflections/ambient
  • Ambient occlusion (no SSAO/GTAO) — nothing feels "grounded"
  • Modern AA (MSAA only) — seats/crowd shimmer
  • Volumetric light pass, depth of field, colour grade/LUT
  • PBR texture maps (grass/concrete/seats) & a true wet-pitch material

3 · The plan — technique roadmap

Prioritised by realism-per-effort. Impact ★ (1–5). We standardise post-processing on pmndrs/postprocessing (one composer, SSAO/GTAO, bloom, DoF, SMAA in a single graph) and gate everything through the quality manager.

A · Lighting & materials (the biggest single jump)

TechniqueWhy it mattersImpactEffort
IBL / HDRI environmentscene.environment = PMREM(night HDRI) — sky & city reflections on the wet pitch, sheen on seats and cloth banners. Free realism for every PBR surface at once.★★★★★Med
PBR texture mapsReal grass (albedo+normal+roughness), concrete, seat rows, ad boards — kills the "flat plastic" look.★★★★Med-Hi
Physical wet pitchMeshPhysicalMaterial clearcoat + roughness/puddle maps → glossy floodlight streaks on the turf.★★★★Med
Area-light floodlightsRectAreaLight banks + emissive housings = soft, physically-plausible light instead of hard spots.★★★Med

B · Post-processing pipeline

TechniqueWhy it mattersImpactEffort
SSAO / GTAOContact shadows in seat gaps, under rails, stand creases — the #1 "grounded, not floating" cue.★★★★Med
Depth of fieldBroadcast lenses have DoF. Focus on the tifo, soften the rest — the single biggest "this isn't a game" tell.★★★★Med
SMAA + TAASMAA everywhere; TAA at Ultra (slow hero cams) → crisp 60k-seat mosaics with zero shimmer.★★★★Med
Colour grade / LUT + AgXCinematic teal-orange LUT, optional AgX tone-map (truer hues than ACES), vignette, subtle grain/chromatic aberration.★★★★Low-Med
Selective bloomBloom only lights/pyro/tifo (not the whole frame) → punchy without washing out.★★★Med

4 · Performance & adaptive quality — the governor

None of this ships without staying smooth. We extend QualitySettings with feature flags — ibl, ao, aaMode, volumetric, dof, grade, crowdDensity, envResolution — and gate them per tier:

  • Medium: SMAA + grade + light beams + IBL(low-res). High: + SSAO + DoF + full IBL + wet pitch. Ultra: + TAA + raymarched god-rays + 4K shadows + rain.
  • Frame-time governor: measure FPS, auto-step the tier down if it dips; render-on-demand when the camera is idle; dynamic resolution scaling; half-res AO/volumetric buffers; PMREM baked once.
  • Future track (R&D, not P1): WebGPU + Three.js RenderPipeline (r183) — node/TSL post-processing and compute-driven crowd. Big migration; evaluate after P2.

5 · Phased roadmap

P1 — Instant lift (low risk, ~2 sessions)
IBL env map + colour grade/AgX + SMAA + SSAO (adopt pmndrs/postprocessing) + bloom tune. Result: looks ~2× more real immediately, on the same geometry.
P2 — Night-match magic
Volumetric beams upgrade + depth of field + physical wet pitch + height fog. Result: the "wow / did you film this?" frame.
P3 — Bring it to life
Crowd billboards + phone-flash + pyro/smoke upgrade + broadcast DoF pulls & hero reveal + audio bed.
P4 — Ultra & polish
TAA + raymarched god-rays + rain variant + per-tier frame governor + cross-device QA + WebGPU R&D.

6 · How we'll know it worked

  • Before/after side-by-side on the same design each phase.
  • Perf budget held: 60fps desktop-High, 30fps mobile-Medium, auto-degrade below.
  • The "would you screenshot this?" test — and a lift in publish/share rate from the Match Day view.

7 · Target look

This is the goal — a hyper-real night match with volumetric floodlights, a crisp emissive tifo, a living crowd, a PBR wet pitch, and a cinematic grade. (Concept mockup illustrating the target, not a screenshot of the current build.)
